      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name

        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

            date.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same lastName and address (normally rejected with 409
            Conflict as a duplicate household). Write-only request flag; it is
            not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners that existed when this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I introduced address normalization for owner creation, mirroring the existing telephone/email normalization precedent in the codebase.

**New files:**
- `util/AddressNormalizer.java` — single source of truth that trims and collapses whitespace, upper-cases, and expands whole-word street-type abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). Returns `null` for a value that is blank after normalization.
- `rest/validation/AddressValidation.java` + `AddressValidator.java` — a Bean Validation constraint that delegates to `AddressNormalizer`, rejecting an address that normalizes to blank (leaving `null` to `@NotBlank`).

**Changed files:**
- `resources/openapi.yml` — added `@AddressValidation` to the `OwnerFields.address` field (alongside `@NotBlank`) and documented the normalization behavior. The DTO is regenerated at build time, so the constraint flows onto the inbound request.
- `mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — the `address` field is now mapped through a `normalizeAddress` qualifier, so the canonical form is what gets stored and returned.
- `service/ClinicServiceImpl.java` — household duplicate detection (and therefore the shared `householdId` assignment) now compares addresses via `AddressNormalizer.normalize(...)`, so the normalized form drives the comparison.

**Behavior changes delivered, per the spec:**
- Addresses are normalized whenever an owner is created; the normalized value is stored and returned (`"  12  main  st "` → `"12 MAIN STREET"`, `"7 elm ave"` → `"7 ELM AVENUE"`).
- The required-field check rejects an address that is blank after normalization (400).
- All address comparisons (household duplicate detection and shared household id) use the normalized form.
